reason: In xorm_store.go:614-617, every non-SQLite path binds one `?` per ID with no chunking, and a batch can hold up to cfg.AnnotationCleanupJobBatchSize IDs (LIMIT at :529/:549/:571). Grafana does not set interpolateParams, so MySQL uses server-side prepares; both MySQL and Postgres cap these at 65535 placeholders, so a batch size above that makes full batches fail. The old single-statement LIMIT SQL bound no parameters at all.
